title: Rainbow Glow
description: Adds a /glow command that gives players a rainbow portal-like effect!
body:
# Rainbow Glow

**Rainbow Glow** is a simple Fabric mod that adds the `/glow` command!  

Use this command to make your character glow like a divine entity — perfect for admins, streamers, or just showing off.  

## Features
- Turn your character into a glowing entity with `/glow`
- Lightweight and super simple
- Fun for roleplay, admin events, or creative screenshots

⚠️ **Alpha Version:** This mod is still in alpha, so you may encounter a few bugs. Feedback is welcome!  

More features are coming soon — stay tuned!
